_readme: Generated MCP names in sources/main/java replaced with readable ones. 'renamed' maps every renamed symbol to its new name; 'allowlist' lists the symbols that keep their generated name, per file, with the reason. Names come from the official MCP 1.8.9/1.8.8 and 1.9.4/1.10.2 mapping sets (stable_22, 26, 29) and, for symbols MCP never named, a reviewed name. The rewrite only touched identifiers; comments were updated where they referred to a renamed member. tests/test_readable_names.py keeps the map and the sources in sync.
